retained_controls.observation: All eight valid readings reject sole author risk despite the hypothetical half-profit offer; the erased exact example is not needed for that decision.

Both input conditions retain desire versus non-imposition, financial versus household constraints, and the story/Portfolio/Appleton dependencies in all four readings per condition. This is scoped preservation, not a claim that every gloss is source-entailed.

The four valid Claude responses preserve waiting versus assumed absence and distinguish hypothetical travel permission, actual departure and invitation outcome. Occasional categorical wording about non-occurrence deserves further calibration.

limits: The sender never saw these questions, but the analyst selected them after inspecting the relays; not an untouched held-out benchmark.
Six questions share one prompt; nearby questions may cue distinctions or supply hypothetical vocabulary. Query packaging is a future control.
Literal or folded quote membership is not entailment, and evidence quotes are not private model reasoning.
Three selected documents, one frozen sender output each, two readers and two repetitions do not support population failure rates or a causal model-family claim.
Visible omissions and substitutions explain these contrasts without covert encoding. Hidden-code use elsewhere remains an untested separate hypothesis.
There is no representation-repair intervention here, hence no demonstrated intelligence gain or proof that a minimal repair would recover downstream reasoning.
